metadata.name: gct-mobile-embedded-regression
metadata.description: Stateful evidence capture for GCT-MOBILE-001 through GCT-MOBILE-006. It records mobile chrome and Changes → Diff → Changes geometry without mutating repository state.

data.label: Open Git Control Tower mobile workspace
Mobile bottom navigation is reachable
data.failureMessage: GCT-MOBILE-006: mobile navigation is not visible in the initial viewport

data.label: Capture root, header, nav, and Changes geometry
data.expression: (() => { const pick = (id) => { const el = document.querySelector(`[data-testid=${id}]`); if (!el) return null; const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return { top:r.top, bottom:r.bottom, height:r.height, scrollTop:el.scrollTop, scrollHeight:el.scrollHeight, clientHeight:el.clientHeight }; }; const scroll = document.querySelector('[data-testid=changes-scroll-region] [data-radix-scroll-area-viewport]') || document.querySelector('[data-testid=changes-scroll-region]'); const scrollRect = scroll?.getBoundingClientRect(); return { viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight}, root:pick('git-control-tower'), header:pick('mobile-header'), nav:pick('mobile-nav'), changes:pick('file-list-panel'), changesScroll:scroll ? {top:scrollRect.top,bottom:scrollRect.bottom,scrollTop:scroll.scrollTop,scrollHeight:scroll.scrollHeight,clientHeight:scroll.clientHeight} : null }; })()

data.label: Scroll the owned Changes region before tab transition
data.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=changes-scroll-region] [data-radix-scroll-area-viewport]') || document.querySelector('[data-testid=changes-scroll-region]'); if (!el) return {missing:true}; const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight, 240)); el.scrollTo({top:target}); return new Promise(resolve => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve({scrollTop:el.scrollTop,scrollHeight:el.scrollHeight,clientHeight:el.clientHeight}))); })()

data.label: Diff panel navigation completes
data.failureMessage: GCT-MOBILE-003: Diff transition did not complete

data.label: Capture Changes geometry after tab restoration
data.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=file-list-panel]'); const nav = document.querySelector('[data-testid=mobile-nav]'); const scroll = document.querySelector('[data-testid=changes-scroll-region] [data-radix-scroll-area-viewport]') || document.querySelector('[data-testid=changes-scroll-region]'); if (!el || !nav || !scroll) return { missing:true }; const panel = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const bottomNav = nav.getBoundingClientRect(); return { changes:{top:panel.top,bottom:panel.bottom}, changesScroll:{scrollTop:scroll.scrollTop,scrollHeight:scroll.scrollHeight,clientHeight:scroll.clientHeight}, nav:{top:bottomNav.top,bottom:bottomNav.bottom}, viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight} }; })()
